text:
olivia: quick sync 1010 need a final pass on the compact alert row and the channel mute flow. spotted a few UX/accessibility nits in the lab.
pete: dropping in screenshots helped. compact row currently shows small icons + a tiny "off" label. users missed which channel was muted when there are >3 channels.
anika: suggestion: collapse less important channels behind a +N menu, but always show the muted channels as visible pills. keeps scanability.
design-bot: figma file: https://figma.com/s/redwood/alerts-compact-row-v2 (see comments: pill-visibility, collapsed-list)
rachel: copy question: current inline label reads "Off". prefer explicit "Notifications off" or "Muted"? In tests, "Muted" was ambiguous.
olivia: I vote for "Notifications off" because it reads as a state, and pairs well with "Notifications on". also easier to include duration: "Notifications off 35m"
pete: accessibility: the pills are non-button elements. they should be interactive (button role) to allow keyboard toggling and focus. add aria-pressed and aria-label includes channel name + status + duration.
anika: example markup suggestion:
```
<button class="pill" aria-pressed="true" aria-label="PagerDuty, notifications off for 45 minutes">PagerDuty 60; off</button>
```
dev-bot: accessibility checklist updated in docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/accessibility/alerts (added pill examples).
tom: animation note: when toggling mute, animate height/opacity for the collapsed area so it doesn't feel jumpy. but add respect for prefers-reduced-motion.
rachel: toast copy is inconsistent: sometimes it shows "Channel muted" and other times "Mute set". propose standardized toast: "Notifications paused for PagerDuty 0m 35m (Undo)". Wait that looks messy. Maybe: "Notifications paused for PagerDuty 0m  Undo".
olivia: simpler is better: "Notifications paused for PagerDuty 0 minutes  Undo" (include channel name, humanized duration, Undo).
pete: keyboard flow: when you hit Enter on a pill to open duration quick menu, focus should move into the menu and pressing Escape should close and return focus to the pill. add aria-controls on the pill to reference the menu id.
anika: small copy nit: we use both "Pause notifications" and "Mute notifications" in different contexts. prefer "Pause notifications" for short temporary durations, "Mute" for permanent. but that may confuse users. thoughts?
taylor: (joined late) my 2c: consistent verbs are good. pick one and document. "Pause" implies a duration; "Mute" could suggest indefinite. I prefer "Pause notifications" for the UI CTA, with a toggle option for "Until turned back on" labelled "Indefinite pause".
olivia: good call. let's standardize on "Pause notifications" for the primary action, and provide an "Indefinite" checkbox for permanent mute. update copy strings accordingly.
design-bot: placing a copy table in the figma file under Notes > Copy Strings.
tom: color contrast: the orange pill on light bg is failing AA for 12px. bump to 14px and adjust color to a darker tone. provide hover and focus states with a clear 3px outline.
pete: also add an accessible color token in design system: "token-alert-pill-muted" with accessible contrast.
anika: suggestion for preview header copy: current "Who will be notified" -> try "Alert recipients and channels" (shorter than "Notified channels & recipients").
olivia: I like "Alert recipients and channels" 60; concise.
rachel: test note: screen reader users preferred a readout that starts with channel name then state: "PagerDuty, notifications paused for 30 minutes". order matters.
olivia: decision summary:
- use "Notifications on" / "Notifications off" for inline state labels
- pills must be buttons with aria-pressed + aria-labels (channel, state, duration)
- bump pill text to 14px and darken color token for AA contrast
- in-place animations: opacity/height with reduced-motion respect
- standardize primary CTA wording to "Pause notifications"; provide "Indefinite pause" option for permanent mute
- toast: "Notifications paused for PagerDuty 0 minutes  Undo" format
- preview header: "Alert recipients and channels"
- keyboard focus flow: Enter opens menu, Escape closes and returns focus

olivia: action items:
- @pete: update the pill component spec + color token (owner)
- @anika: add aria examples and keyboard flow to the spec (owner)
- @rachel: clean up copy strings and add to figma copy table (owner)
- @tom: write animation guidelines and reduced-motion fallback (owner)
- @design-bot: attach updated figma link and mark comments resolved when done

dev-bot: reminder: accessibility review channel tomorrow 4pm. Please tag docs for the pill and toast strings.
olivia: thanks all 44D will post final spec by EOD Friday.
rachel: thanks!
pete: :thumbsup:
